svg.aria-label: Histograms of the standardised mean of exponential data for n equal 1, 2, 5 and 30 against the standard normal curve. At n equal 1 it is a sharp right-skewed exponential; by n equal 30 it nearly matches the bell curve, with skewness falling as 2 over root n
